Add tests for it in tests/test_utils.py and run pytest on tests/test_utils.py.

+def parse_keep_alive_timeout(header_value):
+    try:
+        if not isinstance(header_value, str):
+            logger.warning("Invalid Keep-Alive header value: %r", header_value)
+            return None
+
+        header_value = header_value.strip()
+        if not header_value:
+            return None
+
+        has_invalid_part = False
+        for part in header_value.split(","):
+            part = part.strip()
+            if not part:
+                continue
+            if "=" not in part:
+                has_invalid_part = True
+                continue
+            key, value = part.split("=", 1)
+            key = key.strip().lower()
+            value = value.strip()
+            if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] == '"':
+                value = value[1:-1].strip()
+            if key == "timeout":
+                timeout = float(value)
